terrain.headline: Long gamma — chop regime. Fade the edges, do not chase breakouts.

implied_1d_move.method: S x sigma_ATM x sqrt(1/252), one standard deviation (68.3pct); sigma = mean ATM call/put implied vol of the first expiry at least a day out

lines: Dealers are modelled net long gamma (from OI, not observed positioning): they sell into strength and buy into weakness, damping every move.
Spot 269.43 vs flip 243.91 (-9.47%) — 9.47% above the regime line.
At the lower edge — wait for the reaction at the put wall, do not anticipate.
